title: Tech Note: Building a User-Definable Report/Function Interface

historical_commentary.text: This note describes building a data-driven, user-configurable report and function interface where report names and associated methods are stored in the application data file and presented via drop-down lists with password-group-based access control. The pattern of storing metadata in data tables for dynamic UI generation remains a valid approach, though modern 4D would typically use ORDA, collection-based UI, and more sophisticated access control mechanisms.
related_updates: Modern 4D access control uses more granular permission systems beyond simple password groups
ORDA and collection-based approaches provide more flexible dynamic UI patterns than classic drop-down list population
